references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: ahd. bi nah, spätmhd. binahe

references.title: en.wiktionary: beinahe
references.supports: 'From Middle High German bīnāhe. Analysable as bei + nah'

notes.rationale: in beinahe Jahresfrist, almost a year. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so the en.wiktionary etymology decides: bei + nah, the preposition and the adjective, whose nahe is the frozen -e DWDS's headword nah, nahe spells (ADR 0050). Both judges, system and learner POV, made this correction on 2026-10-26 (#1241).
